title: Duran Duran’s Biggest Billboard Hits: ‘Rio,’ ‘Hungry Like the Wolf’ & More
summary: The band sent 15 classics to the Hot 100’s top 40 in the 1980s and ‘90s.
content: Duran Duran charted 15 hits in the top 40 of the Billboard Hot 100 in 1983-93, a run of synth-pop classics, boosted by stylish videos amid MTV’s most tastemaking era, that led to the band ranking among the 100 top-performing acts in the chart’s history. After John Taylor and Nick Rhodes formed the group in Birmingham, England, in 1978, Duran Duran — by then rounded out by lead singer Simon LeBon, Andy Taylor and Roger Taylor (with none of the Taylors related) — made its Hot 100 debut on Christmas Day 1982 with “Hungry Like the Wolf.” The following March, the single became the group’s first of 11 top 10s, reaching No. 3. After “Rio” hit No. 14 in May 1983, two more Hot 100 top 10s followed that year: “Is There Something I Should Know” and “Union of the Snake.” Duran Duran scored its first Hot 100 No. 1, “The Reflex,” in 1984 and added its second, “A View to a Kill,” in 1985, the latter marking the only leader on the list ever from the James Bond film franchise. Later in the ‘80s, Duran Duran continued to scale the Hot 100’s top 10, while members posted hits via their own ventures, with Andy Taylor joining supergroup Power Station , which scored two top 10s in 1985: “Some Like It Hot” (No. 6) and “Get It On (Bang a Gong)” (No. 9). Related Andy Taylor, Former Duran Duran Guitarist, Dead at 65 Plus, Andy Taylor — who, as announced Nov. 25, died at age 65 — reached No. 24 in 1986 with his solo song “Take It Easy.” Meanwhile, Arcadia — LeBon, Rhodes and Roger Taylor — notched two top 40 Hot 100 hits in 1985-86, led by the No. 6-peaking “Election Day.” In 1993, Duran Duran (then comprising LeBon, Rhodes, John Taylor and Warren Cuccurullo), upped its count to 10 and 11 top 10s thanks to “Ordinary World” and “Come Undone.” Ahead of the group’s enshrinement in the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 2022, LeBon recalled their introduction to Billboard on the Pop Shop Podcast . “I think we came over to America in late 1981 for the very first time. It was a hell of a trip. You can imagine … a bunch of English boys getting off the airplane at JFK,” he chuckled. “We met up with our record company at the time, Capitol Records. We went up into their offices [in New York] and I remember somebody getting out the Billboard magazine. I think the [Hot 100] chart was on the back cover. He said, ‘This is what it’s all about.’ You looked at those names, Bruce Springsteen and others, and thought, ‘Wow, yeah, if only.’ And then one day, I think we were in the U.K. at the time, we knew we’d had a No. 1. They sent us the actual copy [of the chart] with ‘The Reflex’ at No. 1 . That was a really big deal for us.” Below, count down Duran Duran’s 15 biggest Hot 100 hits. Duran Duran’s Biggest Billboard hits chart is based on actual performance on the weekly Billboard Hot 100 through the Nov. 28, 2026, chart. Songs are ranked based on an inverse point system, with weeks at No. 1 earning the greatest value and weeks at No. 100 earning the least. Due to changes in chart methodology over the years, eras are weighted to account for different chart turnover rates over various periods.

title: ‘Hunger Games’ Series Returns to No. 1 on Soundtracks Chart After More Than a Decade
summary: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping — with music by Noah Kahan, Ella Langley & more — bows atop the Soundtracks chart.
content: The Hunger Games is back on top of Billboard ’s Soundtracks chart, as the latest soundtrack from the long-running film series, The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping , debuts at No. 1 on the list dated Nov. 28. The set includes tracks from Noah Kahan , Ella Langley, Kacey Musgraves and Stevie Nicks. Related Noah Kahan Talks Landing Lead Single For ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ Soundtrack: ‘You’re Not Coming to Me For Heartwarming’ Dolly Parton to Receive CNN Heroes Legacy Award, Miley Cyrus to Accept on Her Behalf ESSENCE Festival of Culture Moving On From New Orleans After Three Decades: 'Memories Were Made — And So Was History' It’s the first time an album from the franchise has topped the list since the soundtrack from The Hunger Games: Catching Fire , spent one week at No. 1 on the ranking dated Dec. 7, 2013. That film was the second in the series, following The Hunger Games: Songs From District 12 and Beyond , which ruled for five weeks in 2012. Sunrise On the Reaping is the second prequel of film series, with its events taking place 24 years before those in the first The Hunger Games film. Here’s a look at all of the soundtracks from The Hunger Games series that have charted on the Soundtracks chart, including any companion score albums that have reached the list: Title — Peak, Peak Year The Hunger Games: Songs From District 12 and Beyond – No. 1 for 5 weeks, 2012 The Hunger Games: Original Motion Picture Score – No. 3, 2012 The Hunger Games: Catching Fire – No. 1 for one week, 2013 The Hunger Games: Catching Fire – Original Motion Picture Score – No. 11, 2013 The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1 – No. 3, 2014 The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1: Original Motion Picture Score – No. 10, 2014 The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2 – No. 20, 2015 The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes – No. 3, 2023 The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping , No. 1, 2026

title: U2’s ‘Carnaval de Luz’ Debuts at No. 1 on 3 Billboard Album Charts
summary: It arrives in the top 10 on seven charts in total, including the Billboard 200.
content: U2 ’s latest studio album Carnaval de Luz makes a splash on the Billboard charts as the set launches in the top 10 on seven rankings (dated Nov. 28) – including No. 1 on Top Rock Albums , Vinyl Albums and Indie Store Album Sales . It also stakes a claim in the top 10 on the Billboard 200 (No. 4, the band’s 14th top 10 on the chart), Top Album Sales (No. 2), Top Alternative Albums (No. 2) and Top Rock & Alternative Albums (No. 2). Related U2 Reveal North American Dates For 2027 Greatest Show on Earth World Tour U2’s ‘Carnaval De Luz’ Becomes Its 12th U.K. No. 1 Album, Moving Band Up All-Time Leaderboard U2 Opens 2026 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Ceremony With Surprise Performance U2 captured their first top 10 album on any Billboard chart with The Joshua Tree in 1987, when it debuted at No. 7 on the Billboard 200 dated April 4 of that year, on its way to a nine-week run at No. 1. Carnaval de Luz launches with 49,000 equivalent album units earned in the United States in the week ending Nov. 19, according to Luminate. Of that sum, album sales comprise 42,500 (22,000 from vinyl sales — the band’s best week on vinyl since Luminate began tracking data in 1991), SEA units comprise 5,500 (equaling 5.77 million on-demand official streams of the set’s songs) and TEA units comprise 1,000. The new album was preceded by its lead single “Silencio,” which marked the group’s 45th entry on the Alternative Airplay chart earlier in November (tying Foo Fighters for the most in the chart’s history). On Wednesday night (Nov. 25), U2 will headline the halftime show of the first-ever Thanksgiving Eve NFL game, which kicks off at 8 p.m. ET on Netflix. The veteran band also announced North American dates for The Greatest Show on Earth World Tour this week, launching with an August concert in Miami. Elsewhere on the latest Top Album Sales chart, ATEEZ notches its eighth No. 1 with the chart-topping debut of GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6 , while The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping soundtrack (No. 4) and LNGSHOT’s S.W.I.S.H. (No. 7) also debut.

title: Hold Your Turkeys! Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade Has Been Postponed: Here’s the New Date
summary: As it turns out, Mother Nature spares no man nor parade.
content: After waiting 100 years for the parade’s centennial edition, what’s a few more days? Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day parade will be postponed to Saturday, Nov. 28, because of severe weather. Related 100 Years of Music at Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, For ‘An Audience Aged 1 to 100’ RAYE, Megan Moroney, EJAE & More to Perform at 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Parade: See the Lineup Grammy Nominations 2027: See the Complete List “The safety of our participants and spectators is our top priority, and after close consultation with our City and agency partners, we have made the decision to move this year’s celebration,” Macy’s representatives said Wednesday. Even though organizers had already begun inflating the parade’s iconic balloons, the department store, alongside city officials and the New York Police Department, confirmed the Thanksgiving celebration will commence n Saturday at 8:30 a.m. ET instead. The parade’s delay comes amid a particularly grim forecast for the East Coast. The National Weather Service is predicting a strong storm will impact the area on Thanksgiving Day, inundating it with heavy rain, intense winds and coastal flooding. RAYE, who recently earned a record-tying 11 nominations at the 2027 Grammys, is set to open the broadcast, which will air on NBC, Peacock and Telemundo. The historic parade will march from the Upper West Side to Macy’s Herald Square flagship store, and include performances by Billboard chart-topping stars Megan Mooney and Teddy Swims. Tony and Grammy-nominated Broadway star Megan Hilty will lead a tribute to the late Dolly Parton, who passed in August at age 80. Other celebrities to keep an eye out for in the parade’s eye-popping floats include EJAE of KPop Demon Hunters girl group HUNTR/X, Queen Latifah, Jimmy Fallon and The Roots, JoJo, Keke Palmer, Smash Mouth, Mckenna Grace, K-pop boy band RIIZE, Indigo Girls, Natasha Bedingfield, Feid, Icona Pop, Wyclef Jean, Jamie Miller, Leslie Odom Jr., Anthony Ramos, Melissa Joan Hart, Jamie Miller, Holly Robinson Peete and more. The Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade first marched New York City’s streets in 1924, and it’s only been canceled three times: 1942, 1943 and 1944. During those years, materials for giant balloons were prioritized for World War II efforts over holiday parades. Notably, the balloons were last grounded in 1971 due to severe weather; city regulations dictate that balloons can only fly when wind speeds remain below 23 mph. In 2019, inclement weather forced the balloons to be flown at lower heights than usual. Officials will address the city tonight at 6 p.m. ET.

title: Andy Taylor, Former Duran Duran Guitarist, Dead at 65
summary: The rocker had been battling prostate cancer for about eight years.
content: Andy Taylor , guitarist and former member of Duran Duran , has died after a yearslong battle with prostate cancer. He was 65 years old. Related Former Duran Duran Member Andy Taylor Misses Rock Hall of Fame Induction Because of Stage 4 Cancer Duran Duran’s Andy Taylor Says Cancer Drug Has Extended His Life Five More Years Gone But Not Forgotten: Musicians We Lost in 2026 The musician’s former bandmates shared the news Wednesday (Nov. 25) on their website and on Instagram , announcing that Taylor had passed away two days prior. “Andy was there at the very beginning of our story,” the group wrote. “From the moment he arrived in Birmingham from the North East with a guitar and an unshakeable belief in what we could become, he brought an indelible fire and swagger to our music.” Duran Duran continued, “His playing drove the songs that took us around the world, and with a dry wit that was matched only by his wonderfully unsentimental, no-nonsense outlook on life he kept us grounded and gave the band its edge through the extraordinary years that followed.” Still in its early years, the band added Taylor to the lineup in 1980. He would leave in 1986 before rejoining in 2001, playing guitar on Duran Duran’s 2004 album Astronaut (which reached No. 17 on the Billboard 200 ) before leaving again in 2006. In 2023, he’d contribute guitar to Halloween-themed LP Danse Macabre . During his time in the group, Duran Duran scored 13 hits on the Billboard Hot 100 , including two No. 1s: “The Reflex” in 1984 and “A View to a Kill” in 1985. The group’s blockbuster Rio album (which housed “Hungry Like the Wolf”) hit the Billboard 200 in 1982 and remained on the chart a staggering 128 weeks. As a soloist, he scored two entries on the chart: “Take It Easy” (No. 24 in 1986) and “When the Rain Comes Down” (No. 73 in 1986). As a member of the supergroup The Power Station, he earned three top 40 hits on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1985. Taylor’s wife, Tracey, also shared a statement Wednesday. “To the world, Andy was a brilliant guitarist, but to us, he was the most wonderful husband, a loving dad and the proudest grandfather,” she wrote. “He was the rock of our family. For all the incredible experiences music brought him, family always came first.” His cancer diagnosis was first revealed in 2022, when frontman Simon LeBon told fans at Duran Duran’s induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame — which Taylor did not attend, though he was inducted alongside his bandmates — that he’d already been battling the illness for four years at that point. In 2023, Taylor shared that he’d started taking cancer drug Lutetium-177, which he said extended his life by five years. “Andy faced the last few years with so much courage and determination,” Tracey added in her statement. “He never gave up, fighting until the very end, never losing his love of life. The kindness and support shown to him by fans from all over the world throughout his illness brought him immense comfort and strength, and for that we will always be grateful.” Andy is also survived by his children — Georgina, Isabella, Bethany and Andrew — and grandson Albie.
